title: Going to the hospital
description: No one likes having a fever (发烧). Learn some other key words such as hospital (医院) in today’s beginner reading.

sentences.chinese: 今天早上，我发烧了，就去了医院。我坐在医院的椅子上，等医生看病。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān zǎo shàng， wǒ fā shāo le， jiù qù le yī yuàn。 wǒ zuò zài yī yuàn de yǐ zi shàng， děng yī shēng kàn bìng。
sentences.english: I had a fever this morning and went to the hospital. I sat in the hospital chair and waited for the doctor to see me.

sentences.chinese: 有一个奶奶问我，是不是自己来的医院？我说：“是的。”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí gè nǎi nai wèn wǒ， shì bu shì zì jǐ lái de yī yuàn？ wǒ shuō： “ shì de。 ”
sentences.english: An old woman asked me if I came to the hospital by myself. I said, “Yes.”

sentences.chinese: 她就给了我面包和一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiù gěi le wǒ miàn bāo hé yì bēi shuǐ。
sentences.english: She gave me bread and a glass of water.

sentences.chinese: 我真感动啊！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhēn gǎn dòng a！
sentences.english: I was really touched!

title: Home for a day
description: A Chinese dialogue about heading home for a day. The dialogue continues at HSK 2 and HSK 3 level. The conversation has an informal tone.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：你回来了，我好想你！真开心啊。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nǐ huí lái le， wǒ hǎo xiǎng nǐ！ zhēn kāi xīn a。
sentences.english: Mother：You’re back! I missed you. I’m so happy!

sentences.chinese: 我：是啊妈妈，我也很想你。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： shì a mā ma， wǒ yě hěn xiǎng nǐ。
sentences.english: Me：Yes, I’m back mom, I missed you too.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：你想吃什么？我去给你做饭。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nǐ xiǎng chī shén me？ wǒ qù gěi nǐ zuò fàn。
sentences.english: Mother：What do you want to eat? Ill cook it for you.

sentences.chinese: 我：都可以，妈妈做的我都爱吃。妈妈，房间脏了，我扫一下地。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： dōu kě yǐ， mā ma zuò de wǒ dōu ài chī。 mā ma， fáng jiān zāng le， wǒ sǎo yí xià dì。
sentences.english: Me：Anything is ok, I love to eat anything you cook mom. Mother, this room is a bit messy, I’ll sweep the floor.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：你刚回家，太累了，不用扫地，快去休息吧。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nǐ gāng huí jiā， tài lèi le， bú yòng sǎo dì， kuài qù xiū xi ba。
sentences.english: Mother：You’ve just come home and must be tired. Don’t tidy up, take a rest.

title: What do you do at home?
description: This Chinese dialogue has some key vocabulary: computer (电脑), TV (电视), and TV program (电视节目) .

sentences.chinese: 小红：小明，你在家会干什么？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： xiǎo míng， nǐ zài jiā huì gàn shén me？
sentences.english: 小红：Xiao Ming, what will you do at home?

sentences.chinese: 小明：我会在家玩电脑游戏，你呢？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： wǒ huì zài jiā wán diàn nǎo yóu xì， nǐ ne？
sentences.english: 小明：I will play computer games at home, what about you?

sentences.chinese: 小红：我喜欢在家看电视。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā kàn diàn shì。
sentences.english: 小红：I like to watch tv at home.

sentences.chinese: 小明：你喜欢看什么节目？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nǐ xǐ huan kàn shén me jié mù？
sentences.english: 小明：What programs do you like to watch?

sentences.chinese: 小红：我喜欢看体育比赛。我最喜欢看篮球比赛了！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： wǒ xǐ huan kàn tǐ yù bǐ sài。 wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn lán qiú bǐ sài le！
sentences.english: 小红：I like to watch sport contests. Watching basketball competitions is my favourite!

sentences.chinese: 小明：那周末我们一起看吧！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nà zhōu mò wǒ men yì qǐ kàn ba！
sentences.english: 小明：Then let’s watch together this weekend.

title: Going to Beijing together
description: In this Chinese dialogue, a father and son make plans to go to Beijing (北京). Domestic flights are very cheap in China, and a lot more convenient than taking a train for 10+ hours.

sentences.chinese: 儿子：爸爸，我想去北京。
sentences.pinyin: ér zi： bà ba， wǒ xiǎng qù běi jīng。
sentences.english: Son：Dad, I want to go to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸：为什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: bà ba： wèi shén me ne？
sentences.english: Dad：Why?

sentences.chinese: 儿子：因为北京很好玩儿，我爱北京。
sentences.pinyin: ér zi： yīn wèi běi jīng hěn hǎo wán ér， wǒ ài běi jīng。
sentences.english: Son：Because Biejing is fun, I love Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸：那我们现在就坐出租车去机场吧！
sentences.pinyin: bà ba： nà wǒ men xiàn zài jiù zuò chū zū chē qù jī chǎng ba！
sentences.english: Dad：Then lets go take a taxi to the airport!

sentences.chinese: 儿子：爸爸真好！谢谢爸爸！
sentences.pinyin: ér zi： bà ba zhēn hǎo！ xiè xiè bà ba！
sentences.english: Son：You’re awesome, dad! Thanks dad!

sentences.chinese: 爸爸：不客气。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba： bú kè qì。
sentences.english: Dad：Don’t mention it.

title: My friend gave me a gift
chineseTitle: 我的朋友送给我一个礼物
description: Mandarin reading article at a HSK 1 level. Learn important sentence structures for Chinese beginners.

sentences.chinese: 今天我很高兴，因为我的好朋友送给我一个礼物。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ hěn gāo xìng， yīn wèi wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu sòng gěi wǒ yí gè lǐ wù。
sentences.english: I am very happy today because my good friend gave me a present.

sentences.chinese: 当我回家的时候我会打开这个礼物。
sentences.pinyin: dāng wǒ huí jiā de shí hòu wǒ huì dǎ kāi zhè ge lǐ wù。
sentences.english: I will open this gift when I go home.

sentences.chinese: 我很想知道里面有什么！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng zhī dào lǐ miàn yǒu shén me！
sentences.english: I really want to know what is inside!

sentences.chinese: 我的朋友为什么给我一个礼物呢？ 因为今天是我的生日！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu wèi shén me gěi wǒ yí gè lǐ wù ne？ yīn wèi jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì！
sentences.english: Why did my friend give me a present? Because today is my birthday!

title: Mr Brown’s Garden
description: This Chinese reading describes Mr Brown’s life, and his garden. It uses the word 种 to mean “to plant”. It needs to be pronounced with the 4th tone.

sentences.chinese: 布朗先生住在一个漂亮的房子里。从周一到周五，他在自己家附近的一间办公室里工作。周末的时候，他不需要工作。
sentences.pinyin: bù lǎng xiān shēng zhù zài yí gè piào liang de fáng zi lǐ。 cóng zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ， tā zài zì jǐ jiā fù jìn de yì jiān bàn gōng shì lǐ gōng zuò。 zhōu mò de shí hòu， tā bù xū yào gōng zuò。
sentences.english: Mr. Brown lives in a beautiful house. From Monday to Friday, he works in an office near his home. He doesn’t need to work on weekends.

sentences.chinese: 他还有一个漂亮的花园，他会在花园里种些植物。他很享受在花园里忙碌的时光，那是他最开心的时候。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái yǒu yí gè piào liang de huā yuán， tā huì zài huā yuán lǐ zhǒng xiē zhí wù。 tā hěn xiǎng shòu zài huā yuán lǐ máng lù de shí guāng， nà shì tā zuì kāi xīn de shí hòu。
sentences.english: He also has a beautiful garden where he will plant plants. He enjoys being busy in his garden, that is when he is happiest.

title: My day
description: A passage about going to school. Read slowly before answering the comprehension questions below. 突然 is really useful: it means “suddenly”.

sentences.chinese: 今天我七点醒了。 然后，我穿好衣服了。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ qī diǎn xǐng le。 rán hòu， wǒ chuān hǎo yī fu le。
sentences.english: I woke up at seven o’clock today. Then I got dressed.

sentences.chinese: 我八点半走路去上学。 我不骑自行车，因为车子坏了。 我不坐公共汽车，因为公交车车票太贵了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bā diǎn bàn zǒu lù qù shàng xué。 wǒ bù qí zì xíng chē， yīn wèi chē zǐ huài le。 wǒ bú zuò gōng gòng qì chē， yīn wèi gōng jiāo chē chē piào tài guì le。
sentences.english: I walked to school at half past eight. I don’t ride a bike because my bike is broken. I don’t take the bus because the bus ticket is too expensive.

sentences.chinese: 走路的时候突然下雨了，我讨厌下雨。我喜欢晴天。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu lù de shí hòu tū rán xià yǔ le， wǒ tǎo yàn xià yǔ。 wǒ xǐ huan qíng tiān。
sentences.english: It suddenly rained when I was walking, I hate rain. I like sunny days.

title: Your food delivery might be a little late
chineseTitle: 你的外卖可能会晚到一会
description: 美团外卖 is a company that delivers food in China. You can review delivery drivers and give them one to five stars for their service. It is very common to give 5 stars (五星).

sentences.chinese: 送餐员：您好，我是美团外卖送餐员。不好意思，您的外卖可能会晚到一会，饭店在用餐的顾客太多了。
sentences.pinyin: sòng cān yuán： nín hǎo， wǒ shì měi tuán wài mài sòng cān yuán。 bù hǎo yì si， nín de wài mài kě néng huì wǎn dào yí huì， fàn diàn zài yòng cān de gù kè tài duō le。
sentences.english: Delivery staff: Hello, I am a Meituan delivery driver. Sorry, your takeaway may be late. There are lots of customers at the restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 我：好，我可以等一会。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： hǎo， wǒ kě yǐ děng yí huì。
sentences.english: Me: Ok, I can wait a little.

sentences.chinese: 送餐员：谢谢，我会尽快送到的。
sentences.pinyin: sòng cān yuán： xiè xiè， wǒ huì jǐn kuài sòng dào de。
sentences.english: Delivery staff: Thank you, I will deliver it as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 十分钟以后。。。
sentences.pinyin: shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu。。。
sentences.english: After 10 minutes. . .

sentences.chinese: 送餐员：您好，这是您的外卖。
sentences.pinyin: sòng cān yuán： nín hǎo， zhè shì nín de wài mài。
sentences.english: Delivery staff: Hello, this is your takeaway.

sentences.chinese: 我：谢谢你。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： xiè xiè nǐ。
sentences.english: Me: Thank you.

sentences.chinese: 送餐员：如果您对我的服务满意的话，请稍后给我一个五星好评可以吗？
sentences.pinyin: sòng cān yuán： rú guǒ nín duì wǒ de fú wù mǎn yì de huà， qǐng shāo hòu gěi wǒ yí gè wǔ xīng hǎo píng kě yǐ ma？
sentences.english: Delivery staff: If you are satisfied with my service, could you please give me a five-star rating?

sentences.chinese: 我：没问题!
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： méi wèn tí !
sentences.english: Me: OK!

title: I forgot my mother’s birthday
description: This beginner’s Chinese dialogue talks about forgetting things. 说实话 is useful to know, and is very common in spoken Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 莉莉：艾玛，我有个大麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: lì lì： ài mǎ， wǒ yǒu gè dà má fán。
sentences.english: Lily：Emma, I have a big problem.

sentences.chinese: 艾玛：什么事？
sentences.pinyin: ài mǎ： shén me shì？
sentences.english: Emma：What’s up?

sentences.chinese: 莉莉：明天是我妈妈的生日，但是我还没有买礼物。
sentences.pinyin: lì lì： míng tiān shì wǒ mā ma de shēng rì， dàn shì wǒ hái méi yǒu mǎi lǐ wù。
sentences.english: Lily：It is my mother’s brithday tomorrow, but I haven’t bought her a present.

sentences.chinese: 艾玛：你为什么没有买礼物？
sentences.pinyin: ài mǎ： nǐ wèi shén me méi yǒu mǎi lǐ wù？
sentences.english: Emma：Why didn’t you buy a present?

sentences.chinese: 莉莉：说实话，我忘了。
sentences.pinyin: lì lì： shuō shí huà， wǒ wàng le。
sentences.english: Lily：To be honest, I forgot.

sentences.chinese: 艾玛：那你马上出去买礼物！
sentences.pinyin: ài mǎ： nà nǐ mǎ shàng chū qù mǎi lǐ wù！
sentences.english: Emma：You go out and buy a present immediately!

sentences.chinese: 莉莉：我不知道我应该给她买什么。
sentences.pinyin: lì lì： wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ yīng gāi gěi tā mǎi shén me。
sentences.english: Lily：I don’t know what I should buy for her.

sentences.chinese: 艾玛：我跟你去商场吧，我可以帮你选一个合适的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: ài mǎ： wǒ gēn nǐ qù shāng chǎng ba， wǒ kě yǐ bāng nǐ xuǎn yí gè hé shì de lǐ wù。
sentences.english: Emma：I will go with you to the shopping mall. I can help you choose a suitable present.

sentences.chinese: 莉莉：好的，谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: lì lì： hǎo de， xiè xiè。
sentences.english: Lily：Ok, thank you.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
description: A beginner’s version of the Tortoise (乌龟) and the Hare (兔子). A more precise word for hare is 野兔.

sentences.chinese: 兔子和乌龟在夏天比赛跑步。
sentences.pinyin: tù zi hé wū guī zài xià tiān bǐ sài pǎo bù。
sentences.english: A rabbit and a turtle ran in the summer race.

sentences.chinese: 兔子跑得很快，她看见乌龟还在慢慢地走，就先在树下睡觉了。
sentences.pinyin: tù zi pǎo dé hěn kuài， tā kàn jiàn wū guī hái zài màn màn dì zǒu， jiù xiān zài shù xià shuì jiào le。
sentences.english: The rabbit ran very fast. She saw the turtle walking slowly, and went to sleep under the tree.

sentences.chinese: 乌龟虽然走得很慢，但是他没有停下，一直走。
sentences.pinyin: wū guī suī rán zǒu dé hěn màn， dàn shì tā méi yǒu tíng xià， yì zhí zǒu。
sentences.english: Although the turtle went very slowly, he did not stop and kept going.

sentences.chinese: 兔子睡醒的时候，乌龟已经赢了。
sentences.pinyin: tù zi shuì xǐng de shí hòu， wū guī yǐ jīng yíng le。
sentences.english: When the rabbit woke up, the turtle had already won.

sentences.chinese: 这个故事告诉我们不要放弃，坚持就会有结果。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gù shì gào sù wǒ men bú yào fàng qì， jiān chí jiù huì yǒu jié guǒ。
sentences.english: This story tells us not to give up, and that perseverance will give us results.

title: Is being a teacher good?
description: This Chinese dialogue is quite informal.

sentences.chinese: 小明： 你觉得当老师好吗 ？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nǐ jué de dāng lǎo shī hǎo ma？
sentences.english: 小明：Do you think that being a teacher is good?

sentences.chinese: 小红：很好，老师可以跟小孩玩。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： hěn hǎo， lǎo shī kě yǐ gēn xiǎo hái wán。
sentences.english: 小红：I think it’s good. The teacher can have fun with the children.

sentences.chinese: 小明：我觉得当老师不太好。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： wǒ jué de dāng lǎo shī bú tài hǎo。
sentences.english: 小明：I think that being a teacher isn’t so good.

sentences.chinese: 小红：为什么？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： wèi shén me？
sentences.english: 小红：Why?

sentences.chinese: 小明：因为当老师要讲课，还要改作业，很累，所以我觉得当老师不太好。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： yīn wèi dāng lǎo shī yào jiǎng kè， hái yào gǎi zuò yè， hěn lèi， suǒ yǐ wǒ jué de dāng lǎo shī bú tài hǎo。
sentences.english: 小明：Because teachers have to give classes and mark homework, it’s tiring. This is why I think being a teacher isn’t so good.

sentences.chinese: 小红： 话是这么说，我还是喜欢当老师。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： huà shì zhè me shuō， wǒ hái shì xǐ huan dāng lǎo shī。
sentences.english: 小红：You’ve got a point. I still like being a teacher.

title: How much are the peaches?
description: Buying items at a shop is a very important thing for beginners to learn. 怎么卖 is the same as 多少钱. Both are asking “How much?”. 斤 is a Chinese measurement of weight equivalent to half a kilogram.

sentences.chinese: 小明：老板，请问桃子怎么卖？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： lǎo bǎn， qǐng wèn táo zǐ zěn me mài？
sentences.english: 小明：Shopkeeper，How much are the peaches?

sentences.chinese: 老板：桃子18块一斤。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn： táo zǐ 1 8 kuài yì jīn。
sentences.english: 老板：18 yuan per half kilo.

sentences.chinese: 小明：桃子新鲜吗？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： táo zǐ xīn xiān ma？
sentences.english: 小明：Are they fresh?

sentences.chinese: 老板：刚从树上摘下来的，很新鲜，很甜。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn： gāng cóng shù shàng zhāi xià lái de， hěn xīn xiān， hěn tián。
sentences.english: 老板：Straight from the trees, very fresh and very sweet.

sentences.chinese: 小明：那我要这些，您看多少钱？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nà wǒ yào zhè xiē， nín kàn duō shǎo qián？
sentences.english: 小明：Then I’ll take these. How much will that be?

sentences.chinese: 老板：26块。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn： 2 6 kuài。
sentences.english: 老板：26 yuan

sentences.chinese: 小明：给您30。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： gěi nín 3 0。
sentences.english: 小明：Here’s 30.

sentences.chinese: 老板：好的，找你四块钱。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn： hǎo de， zhǎo nǐ sì kuài qián。
sentences.english: 老板：Ok, I will give you 4 yuan change.

title: What birthday present do you want?
description: Birthdays (生日) are the topic of this Chinese dialogue. Learn how to ask what presents your friend might want!

sentences.chinese: 姐姐：妹妹，你的生日快到了。
sentences.pinyin: jiě jie： mèi mei， nǐ de shēng rì kuài dào le。
sentences.english: Big sister：Sister, it is your birthday soon.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹：对！是后天，我想要生日礼物！
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei： duì！ shì hòu tiān， wǒ xiǎng yào shēng rì lǐ wù！
sentences.english: Little sister：Yes! The day after tomorrow. I want birthday presents!

sentences.chinese: 姐姐：你想要什么？手表吗？
sentences.pinyin: jiě jie： nǐ xiǎng yào shén me？ shǒu biǎo ma？
sentences.english: Big sister：What do you want? A watch?

sentences.chinese: 妹妹：不是，你再猜。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei： bú shì， nǐ zài cāi。
sentences.english: Little sister：No, guess again.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐：是自行车吗？
sentences.pinyin: jiě jie： shì zì xíng chē ma？
sentences.english: Big sister：A bike?

sentences.chinese: 妹妹：对！我想要一辆黑色的自行车。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei： duì！ wǒ xiǎng yào yí liàng hēi sè de zì xíng chē。
sentences.english: Little sister：Correct! I want a black bike.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐：好的，我给你买。
sentences.pinyin: jiě jie： hǎo de， wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi。
sentences.english: Big sister：Ok, I will buy one for you.

title: Does he really like dragons?
description: Chinese idioms are called 成语. The idiom below is 叶公好龙 and it means “to pretend to be fond of something while actually fearing it”.

sentences.chinese: 古代有一个叫叶公的画家，他喜欢龙，在家里画了很多。他希望真的龙会出现。龙知道了，就飞来他的家里。
sentences.pinyin: gǔ dài yǒu yí gè jiào yè gōng de huà jiā， tā xǐ huan lóng， zài jiā lǐ huà le hěn duō。 tā xī wàng zhēn de lóng huì chū xiàn。 lóng zhī dào le， jiù fēi lái tā de jiā lǐ。
sentences.english: In ancient times, there was a painter named Ye Gong. He liked dragons and painted a lot at home. He hoped that the real dragon would appear. A dragon knew his wishes and flew to his home.

sentences.chinese: 他看见真的龙，很害怕，就跑了。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn jiàn zhēn de lóng， hěn hài pà， jiù pǎo le。
sentences.english: He saw the real dragon, felt very scared and ran away.

sentences.chinese: 这个成语的意思是，他自己说喜欢那个东西，但其实不是真的喜欢。
sentences.pinyin: zhè gè chéng yǔ de yì sī shì， tā zì jǐ shuō xǐ huan nà ge dōng xī， dàn qí shí bú shì zhēn de xǐ huan。
sentences.english: The meaning of this idiom is that he said he liked something, but he actually didn’t really like it.

title: I want to buy a watch
description: Today’s beginner dialogue teaches some vital sentences to use when shopping (买东西). 太…了(le) is a very useful construct. 太贵了 means “too expensive”, while 太矮了 means “too short”. Simply place an adjective between 太 and 了.

sentences.chinese: 小明：您好，我要买手表，这个多少钱？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nín hǎo， wǒ yào mǎi shǒu biǎo， zhè ge duō shǎo qián？
sentences.english: 小明：Hello, I want to buy a watch. How much money is this?

sentences.chinese: 服务员：500元。
sentences.pinyin: fú wù yuán： 5 0 0 yuán。
sentences.english: Shop assistant：500 yuan.

sentences.chinese: 小明：这个手表太贵了，有便宜点儿的吗？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： zhè ge shǒu biǎo tài guì le， yǒu pián yi diǎn ér de ma？
sentences.english: 小明：This watch is too expensive, do you have anything cheaper?

sentences.chinese: 服务员：您看这个黑色的，200元。
sentences.pinyin: fú wù yuán： nín kàn zhè ge hēi sè de， 2 0 0 yuán。
sentences.english: Shop assistant：This black watch is 200 yuan.

sentences.chinese: 小明：还有其他颜色吗？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： hái yǒu qí tā yán sè ma？
sentences.english: 小明：Does it come in other colors?

sentences.chinese: 服务员：红色。
sentences.pinyin: fú wù yuán： hóng sè。
sentences.english: Shop assistant：Red.

sentences.chinese: 小明：那我买这个红色的手表吧。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： nà wǒ mǎi zhè ge hóng sè de shǒu biǎo ba。
sentences.english: 小明：Then I will buy this red watch.

title: What is your dream?
description: Learn how to ask someone what they aspire to do, or what their dream is!

sentences.chinese: 小红: 小明，你的理想是什么？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng : xiǎo míng， nǐ de lǐ xiǎng shì shén me？
sentences.english: 小红： Xiao Ming, what is your dream? ( 理想 used like this is essentially asking what someone aspires to be, or what their life ideals are ) .

sentences.chinese: 小明: 我想当一名探险家，去发现世界上别人不知道的地方。你呢？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng : wǒ xiǎng dāng yì míng tàn xiǎn jiā， qù fā xiàn shì jiè shàng bié rén bù zhī dào de dì fāng。 nǐ ne？
sentences.english: 小明 ：I want to be an explorer and discover places in the world that others don’t know about. What about you?

sentences.chinese: 小红: 我想当一名医生。别人生病的时候，我就可以帮助他们，让他们不再痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng : wǒ xiǎng dāng yì míng yī shēng。 bié rén shēng bìng de shí hòu， wǒ jiù kě yǐ bāng zhù tā men， ràng tā men bú zài tòng kǔ。
sentences.english: 小红 ：I want to be a doctor. When others are sick, I can help them and stop them from suffering.

sentences.chinese: 小明: 你真善良!
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng : nǐ zhēn shàn liáng !
sentences.english: 小明 ：You are so kind!

sentences.chinese: 小红: 我当医生以后，一定要研究出不苦的药。这样小朋友们就会不讨厌吃药了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng : wǒ dāng yī shēng yǐ hòu， yí dìng yào yán jiū chū bù kǔ de yào。 zhè yàng xiǎo péng yǒu men jiù huì bù tǎo yàn chī yào le。
sentences.english: 小红 ：After I become a doctor, I definitely want to research medicine that is not bitter. This way children will not hate taking medicine.

sentences.chinese: 小明: 太好了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng : tài hǎo le。
sentences.english: 小明 ：Great.

title: I have to go on my own
description: This short intermediate story tells of a girl who must travel alone to her grandfather’s house.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上妈妈对我说：“我要上班了，你得自己去爷爷家吃饭。” 我正想对妈妈说我从来没有独自去过爷爷家。可是，我的话还没说出口，妈妈就跑的无影无踪了。所以，我只能硬着头皮，穿过黑黑的街道，走到爷爷家。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǎn shàng mā ma duì wǒ shuō： “ wǒ yào shàng bān le， nǐ děi zì jǐ qù yé yé jiā chī fàn。 ” wǒ zhèng xiǎng duì mā ma shuō wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu dú zì qù guò yé yé jiā。 kě shì， wǒ de huà hái méi shuō chū kǒu， mā ma jiù pǎo de wú yǐng wú zōng le。 suǒ yǐ， wǒ zhǐ néng yìng zhe tóu pí， chuān guò hēi hēi de jiē dào， zǒu dào yé ye jiā。
sentences.english: Tonight, my mother said to me: “I am going to work. You must go to your grandfather’s house to eat.” I wanted to tell my mother that I had never been to my grandfather’s house alone. However, no words came out of my mouth and my mother scurried away without a trace. Therefore, I could only brace myself and go through the dark streets to my grandfather’s house.

sentences.chinese: 我很害怕，所以走的特别快，见到邻居也没有打招呼。直到看到爷爷，我才放松下来。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn hài pà， suǒ yǐ zǒu de tè bié kuài， jiàn dào lín jū yě méi yǒu dǎ zhāo hū。 zhí dào kàn dào yé ye， wǒ cái fàng sōng xià lái。
sentences.english: I was scared, so I walked very fast and didn’t say hello when I saw my neighbor. I didn’t relax until I saw my grandfather.

title: Renting a house
description: Renting is very common in China as house prices are very high, whereas rent is reasonable. The word rent (租) can be found in lots of words such as taxi (出租车).

sentences.chinese: 小明：我想租房子。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： wǒ xiǎng zū fáng zi。
sentences.english: 小明：I want to rent a house.

sentences.chinese: 小红：你看好房子了吗？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： nǐ kàn hǎo fáng zi le ma？
sentences.english: 小红：Have you checked the house out?

sentences.chinese: 小明：看好了，在学校北门附近。房子有一间卧室、一间客厅和一个厨房，挺好的。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： kàn hǎo le， zài xué xiào běi mén fù jìn。 fáng zi yǒu yì jiān wò shì 、 yì jiān kè tīng hé yí gè chú fáng， tǐng hǎo de。
sentences.english: 小明：Yes, it is near the school’s north gate. It has a bedroom, living room and a kitchen. It’s great.

sentences.chinese: 小红：那你为什么不租？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： nà nǐ wèi shén me bù zū？
sentences.english: 小红：So why don’t you rent it?

sentences.chinese: 小明：因为租金有点儿贵，1000块一个月。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng： yīn wèi zū jīn yǒu diǎn er guì， yì qiān kuài yí gè yuè。
sentences.english: 小明：Because the rent is a bit expensive, 1000 yuan per month.

sentences.chinese: 小红：那是有点儿贵了，我们可以再看看。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo hóng： nà shì yǒu diǎn er guì le， wǒ men kě yǐ zài kàn kàn。
sentences.english: 小红：It is a bit expensive, let’s keep looking.

title: A day with my girlfriend
description: This Mandarin reading is about spending the day with your girlfriend (女朋友).

sentences.chinese: 今天早上，我去机场接我的女朋友，但是她的航班晚点了，我等了她两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān zǎo shàng， wǒ qù jī chǎng jiē wǒ de nǚ péng yǒu， dàn shì tā de háng bān wǎn diǎn le， wǒ děng le tā liǎng gè xiǎo shí。
sentences.english: This morning, I went to the airport to pick up my girlfriend, but her flight was late, I waited for her for two hours.

sentences.chinese: 中午的时候，她感冒了，不舒服，所以我们去超市买新鲜的菜，回家自己煮饭。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng wǔ de shí hòu， tā gǎn mào le， bù shū fú， suǒ yǐ wǒ men qù chāo shì mǎi xīn xiān de cài， huí jiā zì jǐ zhǔ fàn。
sentences.english: At noon, she caught a cold and was uncomfortable, so we went to the supermarket to buy fresh vegetables and went home to cook.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，她感觉好点儿了，我们就一起打游戏和听音乐。我们的一天太快乐了！
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shàng， tā gǎn jué hǎo diǎn ér le， wǒ men jiù yì qǐ dǎ yóu xì hé tīng yīn yuè。 wǒ men de yì tiān tài kuài lè le！
sentences.english: In the evening she felt better. We played games and listened to music together. Our day was so happy!

title: To mend the fold after the sheep are lost
description: The title of this article is 亡羊补牢. It is a Chinese idiom that can mean “to act belatedly” or “better late than never”. Idioms in Chinese are commonly made up of 4 characters.

sentences.chinese: 从前有个人养了很多羊，但是没有给羊建一个羊圈。
sentences.pinyin: cóng qián yǒu gè rén yǎng le hěn duō yáng， dàn shì méi yǒu gěi yáng jiàn yí gè yáng juàn。
sentences.english: In the past, a man raised a lot of sheep, but did not build a sheep pen for them.

sentences.chinese: 有一天晚上，从山上跑下来很多狼，吃掉了他十只羊。他很后悔，他应该给羊建一个好的羊圈。 在羊被吃掉了以后，他才给羊建了一个羊圈。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān wǎn shàng， cóng shān shàng pǎo xià lái hěn duō láng， chī diào le tā shí zhī yáng。 tā hěn hòu huǐ， tā yīng gāi gěi yáng jiàn yí gè hǎo de yáng juàn。 zài yáng bèi chī diào le yǐ hòu， tā cái gěi yáng jiàn le yí gè yáng juàn。
sentences.english: One night, a lot of wolves ran down the hill and ate ten of his sheep. He regretted not building a sheep pen like he should have. Only after his sheep were eaten did he construct a sheep pen.

sentences.chinese: 这个成语的意思是，事情已经发生了，才补救。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge chéng yǔ de yì sī shì， shì qíng yǐ jīng fā shēng le， cái bǔ jiù。
sentences.english: The meaning of this idiom is that events have already happened, and only then are they remedied.

title: The Blind Men and an Elephant
description: 盲 means “blind”. This intermediate Mandarin short story is about three blind men.

sentences.chinese: 三个盲人想知道大象长什么样子，就摸一头大象。
sentences.pinyin: sān gè máng rén xiǎng zhī dào dà xiàng cháng shén me yàng zi， jiù mō yì tóu dà xiàng。
sentences.english: The three blind people wanted to know what an elephant looked like, so they felt an elephant.

sentences.chinese: 第一个盲人摸到象腿，他说大象像一根大棍子；
sentences.pinyin: dì yī gè máng rén mō dào xiàng tuǐ， tā shuō dà xiàng xiàng yì gēn dà gùn zi；
sentences.english: The first blind person touched the elephant’s leg. He said that the elephant is like a big stick.

sentences.chinese: 第二个摸到象尾巴，他说大象像一条绳子；
sentences.pinyin: dì èr gè mō dào xiàng wěi ba， tā shuō dà xiàng xiàng yì tiáo shéng zi；
sentences.english: The second one touched the tail. He said that the elephant is like a rope.

sentences.chinese: 第三个摸到象牙，他说大象像一个大萝卜。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān gè mō dào xiàng yá， tā shuō dà xiàng xiàng yí gè dà luó bo。
sentences.english: The third touched the ivory. He said that the elephant is like a big radish.

sentences.chinese: 这个成语告诉我们，看到的是事情的一部分，不是全部。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge chéng yǔ gào sù wǒ men， kàn dào de shì shì qíng de yí bù fen， bú shì quán bù。
sentences.english: This idiom tells us that what we see is only part of the story, not all of it.

title: Home for a month
description: A continuation of the dialogue found both in our HSK 1 and HSK 2 sections. This continues on an intermediate level. The conversation has an informal tone.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：你每天都在家干什么？也不出去跟朋友玩。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nǐ měi tiān dōu zài jiā gàn shén me？ yě bù chū qù gēn péng yǒu wán。
sentences.english: Mother：What do you do at home everyday? You never go out with your friends.

sentences.chinese: 我：不是您让我在家陪你们的吗？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： bú shì nín ràng wǒ zài jiā péi nǐ men de ma？
sentences.english: Me：Don’t you want me to stay at home and accompany you?

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：那你也不能每天都在家啊！你要和别人沟通，交流。每天在家就知道玩游戏。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nà nǐ yě bù néng měi tiān dōu zài jiā a！ nǐ yào hé bié rén gōu tōng， jiāo liú。 měi tiān zài jiā jiù zhī dào wán yóu xì。
sentences.english: Mother：You can’t stay at home everyday! You must communicate and talk with other people. All you do at home is play games!

sentences.chinese: 我：我知道了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： wǒ zhī dào le。
sentences.english: Me：Ok.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈：你知道你为什么会感冒吗？就是因为在家玩手机玩太多了。现在就去跑步吧。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma： nǐ zhī dào nǐ wèi shén me huì gǎn mào ma？ jiù shì yīn wèi zài jiā wán shǒu jī wán tài duō le。 xiàn zài jiù qù pǎo bù ba。
sentences.english: Mother：Do you know why you always have a cold? It’s because you stay home and use your phone too much. Now go for a run.

sentences.chinese: 我：那好吧。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ： nà hǎo ba。
sentences.english: Me：Alright then.

title: My birthday
description: This Chinese passage is talking about a birthday (生日).

sentences.chinese: 今天是我的生日，早上，妈妈给我煮了一碗面条，因为在中国北方，生日的时候吃的面条，有身体健康的意思。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì， zǎo shàng， mā ma gěi wǒ zhǔ le yì wǎn miàn tiáo， yīn wèi zài zhōng guó běi fāng， shēng rì de shí hòu chī de miàn tiáo， yǒu shēn tǐ jiàn kāng de yì sī。
sentences.english: Today is my birthday. In the morning, my mother cooked a bowl of noodles because in the north of China we eat healthy noodles for our birthdays.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，我和家人，朋友一起吃了蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shàng， wǒ hé jiā rén， péng yǒu yì qǐ chī le dàn gāo。
sentences.english: In the evening, I ate cake with my family and friends.

sentences.chinese: 回家以后，爸爸妈妈还送了生日礼物给我，是蓝色的手表，我好开心！
sentences.pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu， bà bà mā ma hái sòng le shēng rì lǐ wù gěi wǒ， shì lán sè de shǒu biǎo， wǒ hǎo kāi xīn！
sentences.english: After returning home, Mom and Dad also gave me a birthday present; it was a blue watch. I am very happy!

title: My friend
description: Friends (朋友) are important. Learn how to describe your friends in this intermediate Chinese dialogue.

sentences.chinese: 我的好朋友是一个女孩。她个子不高，长得很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu shì yí gè nǚ hái。 tā gè zi bù gāo， cháng dé hěn kě ài。
sentences.english: My good friend is a girl. She is not tall and looks very cute.

sentences.chinese: 她不但聪明，而且认真，她喜欢去图书馆学习，所以每次考试成绩都很好。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú dàn cōng ming， ér qiě rèn zhēn， tā xǐ huan qù tú shū guǎn xué xí， suǒ yǐ měi cì kǎo shì chéng jì dōu hěn hǎo。
sentences.english: She is not only smart, but also serious. She likes to go to the library to study, so all her test scores are very good.

sentences.chinese: 她很热情，总是关心别人，如果别人有困难，她一定会帮助别人解决问题。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn rè qíng， zǒng shì guān xīn bié rén， rú guǒ bié rén yǒu kùn nán， tā yí dìng huì bāng zhù bié rén jiě jué wèn tí。
sentences.english: She is very enthusiastic and always cares about others. If others have difficulties, she will definitely help them solve their problems.

sentences.chinese: 她有很多爱好，比如踢足球、爬山。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu hěn duō ài hào， bǐ rú tī zú qiú 、 pá shān。
sentences.english: She has many hobbies, such as playing football and mountain climbing.

title: A finishing touch
description: Learn the story behind the idiom 画龙点睛. Using idioms wisely can vastly improve your Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 中国古代有一个画家，他的龙画得非常好。有一天，他在墙上画了四条龙。人们看见龙，觉得很美丽，但是没有眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó gǔ dài yǒu yí gè huà jiā， tā de lóng huà dé fēi cháng hǎo。 yǒu yì tiān， tā zài qiáng shàng huà le sì tiáo lóng。 rén men kàn jiàn lóng， jué de hěn měi lì， dàn shì méi yǒu yǎn jīng。
sentences.english: There was a painter in ancient China, and he painted dragons very well. One day, he drew four dragons on the wall. People saw the dragons and thought they were beautiful, but the dragons had no eyes.

sentences.chinese: 画家说：“画上眼睛，龙就会飞走。”大家不相信，他就给龙画上了眼睛，龙真的飞走了。
sentences.pinyin: huà jiā shuō： “ huà shàng yǎn jīng， lóng jiù huì fēi zǒu。 ” dà jiā bù xiāng xìn， tā jiù gěi lóng huà shàng le yǎn jīng， lóng zhēn de fēi zǒu le。
sentences.english: The painter said “If you paint eyes, the dragons will fly away.” People didn’t believe him so he drew the dragon’s eyes and the dragons really flew away.

sentences.chinese: 这个成语的意思是，写文章时在重要的地方加上一些话，会让文章更好。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge chéng yǔ de yì sī shì， xiě wén zhāng shí zài zhòng yào de dì fāng jiā shàng yì xiē huà， huì ràng wén zhāng gèng hǎo。
sentences.english: The meaning of this idiom is that adding something in an important place when writing an essay will make the essay better.

title: Three clever animals
description: This is a slightly strange article describing 3 animals in a picture. Note how the measure word for animals is 只 for the monkey and bear, but 头 for the pig.

sentences.chinese: 今天我看到一副很有趣的图片，图片当中有三只动物在运木头。一只猴子，一只灰熊和一头猪。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ kàn dào yí fù hěn yǒu qù de tú piàn， tú piàn dāng zhōng yǒu sān zhī dòng wù zài yùn mù tou。 yì zhī hóu zi， yì zhī huī xióng hé yì tóu zhū。
sentences.english: Today I saw a very amusing picture of three animals moving a log. A monkey, a grizzly bear and a pig.

sentences.chinese: 猴子把木头放在水里让木头乘着水流流动，手里牵着拴到木头的绳子。
sentences.pinyin: hóu zǐ bǎ mù tou fàng zài shuǐ lǐ ràng mù tou chéng zhe shuǐ liú liú dòng， shǒu lǐ qiān zhe shuān dào mù tou de shéng zi。
sentences.english: The monkey put the log in the water and let the log flow with the water, grasping a rope that was fastened to the log.

sentences.chinese: 强壮的灰熊把木头高高地举起来。
sentences.pinyin: qiáng zhuàng de huī xióng bǎ mù tou gāo gāo dì jǔ qǐ lái。
sentences.english: The strong grizzly bear lifted the log high.

sentences.chinese: 小猪用腿踢着木头向前挪动。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhū yòng tuǐ tī zhe mù tou xiàng qián nuó dòng。
sentences.english: The pig kicked the log forward with his legs.

sentences.chinese: 你觉得哪一个动物的方式更加聪明呢？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ yí gè dòng wù de fāng shì gèng jiā cōng ming ne？
sentences.english: Which animal do you think is smarter?

title: My boyfriend’s annoying habit!
chineseTitle: 我的男朋友喜欢玩电脑游戏
description: Learn how to complain about your significant other’s annoying habits by reading this intermediate Chinese article.

sentences.chinese: 我的男朋友姓刘，他很高，长得也很帅。我们在一起的日子，每天都特别开心。我很爱他。但是，有一点，我特别讨厌他。那就是玩游戏。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de nán péng yǒu xìng liú， tā hěn gāo， cháng dé yě hěn shuài。 wǒ men zài yì qǐ de rì zi， měi tiān dōu tè bié kāi xīn。 wǒ hěn ài tā。 dàn shì， yǒu yì diǎn， wǒ tè bié tǎo yàn tā。 nà jiù shì wán yóu xì。
sentences.english: My boyfriend’s surname is Liu, he is very tall and looks very handsome. We are very happy every day when we are together. I love him very much. However, there is one little thing I especially hate. That is playing games.

sentences.chinese: 他每天晚上下班以后，都会花好几个小时的时间来玩游戏，坐在椅子上一动不动，盯着电脑屏幕。我和他说话的时候，他也是爱搭不理。而且，他会花很多钱，用来买游戏的装备等等。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān wǎn shàng xià bān yǐ hòu， dōu huì huā hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí de shí jiān lái wán yóu xì， zuò zài yǐ zi shàng yí dòng bu dòng， dīng zhe diàn nǎo píng mù。 wǒ hé tā shuō huà de shí hòu， tā yě shì ài dā bù lǐ。 ér qiě， tā huì huā hěn duō qián， yòng lái mǎi yóu xì de zhuāng bèi děng děng。
sentences.english: After work every night, he spends hours playing games, sitting in a chair and staring at the computer screen. When I talk to him, he is indifferent! Moreover, he will spend a lot of money to buy gaming equipment and so on.

sentences.chinese: 我十分讨厌这一点。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shí fēn tǎo yàn zhè yì diǎn。
sentences.english: I hate this very much.

title: Xiao Ming’s day
description: A Chinese passage about Xiao Ming’s day complete with Pinyin and translations.

sentences.chinese: 小明六点起床，六点半之前洗漱，六点半吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng liù diǎn qǐ chuáng， liù diǎn bàn zhī qián xǐ shù， liù diǎn bàn chī zǎo fàn。
sentences.english: Xiao Ming wakes up at six o’clock, washes before half past six, and has breakfast at half past six.

sentences.chinese: 七点钟的时候，他会准时离开家， 小明经常骑车子去上学，大约二十分钟以后他会到达学校，
sentences.pinyin: qī diǎn zhōng de shí hòu， tā huì zhǔn shí lí kāi jiā， xiǎo míng jīng cháng qí chē zi qù shàng xué， dà yuē èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu tā huì dào dá xué xiào，
sentences.english: At seven o’clock, he leaves home on time. Xiao Ming often rides a bicycle to go to school. He arrives at the school after about twenty minutes.

sentences.chinese: 从周一到周五，每天早晨他有四节课。他特别擅长学习英语。
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhōu yí dào zhōu wǔ， měi tiān zǎo chén tā yǒu sì jié kè。 tā tè bié shàn cháng xué xí yīng yǔ。
sentences.english: From Monday to Friday, he has four classes every morning. He is especially good at learning English.

sentences.chinese: 他长大以后，想要当一名英语老师，所以高中的时候，他会去英国留学。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu， xiǎng yào dāng yì míng yīng yǔ lǎo shī， suǒ yǐ gāo zhōng de shí hòu， tā huì qù yīng guó liú xué。
sentences.english: When he grows up, he wants to be an English teacher, so when he is in high school, he will go to the UK to study.

title: Criticism at work
description: Read below to find out how to deliver criticism (批评) to an underperforming worker.

sentences.chinese: 老板: 小王，你来我办公室一趟。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn : xiǎo wáng， nǐ lái wǒ bàn gōng shì yí tàng。
sentences.english: Boss: Xiao Wang, come to my office.

sentences.chinese: 小王: 您好，老板。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng : nín hǎo， lǎo bǎn。
sentences.english: 小王: Hello, boss.

sentences.chinese: 老板: 最近，你所在的项目组完成工作进度太慢了，不能按照计划完成任务，已经导致其他项目组工作的滞后。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn : zuì jìn， nǐ suǒ zài de xiàng mù zǔ wán chéng gōng zuò jìn dù tài màn le， bù néng àn zhào jì huà wán chéng rèn wu， yǐ jīng dǎo zhì qí tā xiàng mù zǔ gōng zuò de zhì hòu。
sentences.english: Boss: Recently, your project team has been working too slowly to complete the task as planned, which has led to the slowing down of other project teams.

sentences.chinese: 小王: 老板，情况的确如您所说的那样。但是进度慢的原因是项目在开展过程中，人手不足。咱们公司裁员了不少。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng : lǎo bǎn， qíng kuàng dí què rú nín suǒ shuō de nà yàng。 dàn shì jìn dù màn de yuán yīn shì xiàng mù zài kāi zhǎn guò chéng zhōng， rén shǒu bù zú。 zán men gōng sī cái yuán le bù shǎo。
sentences.english: 小王: Boss, the situation is indeed as you said. However, the reason for the slow progress is that the project has been under-staffed during the development process. Our company has laid off a lot of staff.

sentences.chinese: 老板: 这个问题的确存在。但是还是希望你们能够提高工作效率，不要拖公司后退。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn : zhè ge wèn tí dí què cún zài。 dàn shì hái shì xī wàng nǐ men néng gòu tí gāo gōng zuò xiào lǜ， bú yào tuō gōng sī hòu tuì。
sentences.english: Boss: This problem is indeed true. But I still hope that you can improve your work efficiency and prevent further delays for the company.

title: Tree Planting Day
description: Also known in English as Arbor Day. People not just in China but all over the world are encouraged to plant trees! Different countries have different days for this festival, in China it is on the 12th of March.

sentences.chinese: 每年的3月12日是植树节。这一天小区的工作人员号召我们在小区里植树。
sentences.pinyin: měi nián de sān yuè shí èr rì shì zhí shù jié。 zhè yì tiān xiǎo qū de gōng zuò rén yuán hào zhào wǒ men zài xiǎo qū lǐ zhí shù。
sentences.english: Every March 12th is “Tree Planting Day”. On this day, the community workers call us to plant trees in the community.

sentences.chinese: 早晨，我很兴奋的起床，早早的来到小区的花园里。爸爸帮我扶着一棵小树苗，我用尽全身的力气把土盖在树苗的根上，然后妈妈在旁边帮我浇水。之后我在这棵小树苗上拴上了一条绳子，用来标记这是我种的树。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo chén， wǒ hěn xīng fèn de qǐ chuáng， zǎo zǎo de lái dào xiǎo qū de huā yuán lǐ。 bà ba bāng wǒ fú zhe yì kē xiǎo shù miáo， wǒ yòng jìn quán shēn de lì qi bǎ tǔ gài zài shù miáo de gēn shàng， rán hòu mā ma zài páng biān bāng wǒ jiāo shuǐ。 zhī hòu wǒ zài zhè kē xiǎo shù miáo shàng shuān shàng le yì tiáo shéng zi， yòng lái biāo jì zhè shì wǒ zhòng de shù。
sentences.english: In the morning, I excitedly get up and go to the garden of the community early. Dad helps me with a small sapling. I use all my strength to cover the roots of the sapling with soil, and then my mother helps me to water it. Then I put a rope on the sapling to mark it as a tree that I planted.

sentences.chinese: 希望有一天这颗小树苗能够长成参天大树，希望我们的环境能够变得越来越好！今天真是开心的一天。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng yǒu yì tiān zhè kē xiǎo shù miáo néng gòu zhǎng chéng cān tiān dà shù， xī wàng wǒ men de huán jìng néng gòu biàn de yuè lái yuè hǎo！ jīn tiān zhēn shì kāi xīn de yì tiān。
sentences.english: I hope that one day this small sapling will grow into a towering tree, I hope our environment can get better and better! Today is a happy day.

title: Winter holiday is here!
description: Students have a month off school for Spring Festival. This time can also be know as a Winter Holiday (寒假). As a HSK 4 article, the sentence structures are more complex than HSK 3.

sentences.chinese: 学生们期盼已久的寒假终于来到了。结束了紧张的期末考试，中国学生将会有大约一个月的寒假时间。这段时间，学生们可以自由玩耍，让他们拥有充沛的精力，活跃的思维。
sentences.pinyin: xué shēng men qī pàn yǐ jiǔ de hán jià zhōng yú lái dào le。 jié shù le jǐn zhāng de qī mò kǎo shì， zhōng guó xué shēng jiāng huì yǒu dà yuē yí gè yuè de hán jià shí jiān。 zhè duàn shí jiān， xué shēng men kě yǐ zì yóu wán shuǎ， ràng tā men yōng yǒu chōng pèi de jīng lì， huó yuè de sī wéi。
sentences.english: The winter vacation that the students have been waiting for has finally arrived. Finishing the intense final exams, Chinese students will have about one month of winter vacation time. During this time, students are free to play, letting them actively think and giving them plentiful amounts of energy.

sentences.chinese: 当然了，寒假当中老师也会布置一部分作业，需要同学们认真完成。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán le， hán jiǎ dāng zhōng lǎo shī yě huì bù zhì yí bù fen zuò yè， xū yào tóng xué men rèn zhēn wán chéng。
sentences.english: Of course, during the winter vacation, the teacher will also arrange homework which students must be serious about completing.

sentences.chinese: 在寒假里，中国学生会度过中国的传统节日——春节。那一天，各地的家人会回到家里与大家团聚。
sentences.pinyin: zài hán jià lǐ， zhōng guó xué shēng huì dù guò zhōng guó de chuán tǒng jié rì — — chūn jié。 nà yì tiān， gè dì de jiā rén huì huí dào jiā lǐ yǔ dà jiā tuán jù。
sentences.english: During the winter vacation, Chinese students will celebrate the traditional Chinese festival, the Spring Festival. On that day, family members from all over the world will return home to reunite with everyone.

sentences.chinese: 寒假真是一段兴奋的时光!
sentences.pinyin: hán jià zhēn shì yí duàn xīng fèn de shí guāng !
sentences.english: Winter vacation is really a time of excitement!

title: Twins
description: An article about twins (双胞胎) and their personalities.

sentences.chinese: 李明和李强是双胞胎兄弟，他们都十二岁了。他们看起来真像。但他们有不同的爱好。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ míng hé lǐ qiáng shì shuāng bāo tāi xiōng dì， tā men dōu shí èr suì le。 tā men kàn qǐ lái zhēn xiàng。 dàn tā men yǒu bù tóng de ài hào。
sentences.english: Li Ming and Li Qiang are twin brothers, both of whom are 12 years old. They look alike. But they have different hobbies.

sentences.chinese: 李明喜欢邮票。他收集了许多漂亮的邮票。但是李强不喜欢收集邮票，他喜欢赛车，喜欢发牢骚。他们两个人都喜欢看科学书。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ míng xǐ huan yóu piào。 tā shōu jí le xǔ duō piào liang de yóu piào。 dàn shì lǐ qiáng bù xǐ huan shōu jí yóu piào， tā xǐ huan sài chē， xǐ huan fā láo sāo。 tā men liǎng gè rén dōu xǐ huan kàn kē xué shū。
sentences.english: Li Ming likes stamps. He has collected many beautiful stamps. But Li Qiang does not like to collect stamps. He likes racing and complaining. Both of them like to read science books.

sentences.chinese: 星期天，他们通常骑自行车去读书。他们在那里和朋友一起玩。然后一起回家写作业。他们在同一所学校上学，很多老师和学生会把他们两个人弄混。我知道怎么区分他们两个，但是我不会告诉老师们！
sentences.pinyin: xīng qī tiān， tā men tōng cháng qí zì xíng chē qù dú shū。 tā men zài nà lǐ hé péng yǒu yì qǐ wán。 rán hòu yì qǐ huí jiā xiě zuò yè。 tā men zài tóng yì suǒ xué xiào shàng xué， hěn duō lǎo shī hé xué shēng huì bǎ tā men liǎng gè rén nòng hùn。 wǒ zhī dào zěn me qū fēn tā men liǎng gè， dàn shì wǒ bú huì gào sù lǎo shī men！
sentences.english: On Sundays, they usually go to school by bicycle. They play there with their friends. Then they go home together and write homework. They go to the same school, and many teachers and students will confuse who is who. I know how to distinguish between the two, but I won’t tell the teachers!

title: Artifical Intelligence!
description: A Mandarin Chinese passage about artificial intelligence (人工智能).

sentences.chinese: 人工智能是当代社会最有益的助手之一。
sentences.pinyin: rén gōng zhì néng shì dāng dài shè huì zuì yǒu yì de zhù shǒu zhī yī。
sentences.english: In modern society, artificial intelligence is one of the most helpful assistants.

sentences.chinese: 可能你对这个名词还不是很理解，或者觉得这个名词高大上。我给你举个最简单的例子，你可以随时对着自己的智能水壶说，为我煮咖啡。它就会开始为你准备咖啡了。
sentences.pinyin: kě néng nǐ duì zhè ge míng cí hái bú shì hěn lǐ jiě， huò zhě jué de zhè ge míng cí gāo dà shàng。 wǒ gěi nǐ jǔ gè zuì jiǎn dān de lì zǐ， nǐ kě yǐ suí shí duì zhe zì jǐ de zhì néng shuǐ hú shuō， wèi wǒ zhǔ kā fēi。 tā jiù huì kāi shǐ wèi nǐ zhǔn bèi kā fēi le。
sentences.english: Maybe you don’t understand the term well, or think the term is too lofty. I will give you the simplest example. You can say to your smart kettle “make coffee for me”. It will start to prepare coffee for you.

sentences.chinese: 科技真是为人们的生活带来了很大帮助。
sentences.pinyin: kē jì zhēn shì wèi rén men de shēng huó dài lái le hěn dà bāng zhù。
sentences.english: Technology is really helping people’s lives.

title: Healthy and unhealthy foods
chineseTitle: 健康食物和不健康食物
description: A Chinese reading passage talking about healthy and unhealthy foods.

sentences.chinese: 健康对任何人来说都是很重要的，尤其是孩子和老年人。因此，在选择食物的时候，人们会区分什么样的食物是健康的，什么样的食物是不健康的。
sentences.pinyin: jiàn kāng duì rèn hé rén lái shuō dōu shì hěn zhòng yào de， yóu qí shì hái zi hé lǎo nián rén。 yīn cǐ， zài xuǎn zé shí wù de shí hòu， rén men huì qū fēn shén me yàng de shí wù shì jiàn kāng de， shén me yàng de shí wù shì bú jiàn kāng de。
sentences.english: Being healthy is important for all people, especially children and seniors. For this reason, when choosing food to eat, people will differentiate which types of food are healthy and which types are unhealthy.

sentences.chinese: 在一般人看来，水果和新鲜的蔬菜对身体是有帮助的。但是在快餐店里卖的食物，比如，汉堡，薯条，大家认为是不健康的。所以要少吃。
sentences.pinyin: zài yì bān rén kàn lái， shuǐ guǒ hé xīn xiān de shū cài duì shēn tǐ shì yǒu bāng zhù de。 dàn shì zài kuài cān diàn lǐ mài de shí wù， bǐ rú， hàn bǎo， shǔ tiáo， dà jiā rèn wéi shì bú jiàn kāng de。 suǒ yǐ yào shǎo chī。
sentences.english: For ordinary people, fruit and fresh vegetables are helpful but the food you can purchase in Fast Food restaurants, such as burgers and french fries, everyone recognises them to be unhealthy and should eat less of them.

sentences.chinese: 可是，在现代人的生活中，不健康的食物又随处可见，能够比较方便的购买到。尤其是上班族，他们没有时间自己做饭，只能去快餐店里购买食物。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì， zài xiàn dài rén de shēng huó zhōng， bú jiàn kāng de shí wù yòu suí chù kě jiàn， néng gòu bǐ jiào fāng biàn de gòu mǎi dào。 yóu qí shì shàng bān zú， tā men méi yǒu shí jiān zì jǐ zuò fàn， zhǐ néng qù kuài cān diàn lǐ gòu mǎi shí wù。
sentences.english: However, in the life of modern people, unhealthy food can be seen everywhere. It is more convenient to buy. Especially when people have finished working, they don’t have time to cook for themselves. They just want to go to a Fast Food restaurant to buy food.
